snippet.title: Release Trailer Artex Exodus: The Colonization of Space
snippet.description: Out now: Exodus - The Colonization of Space - after 28 years! Colonize a galaxy in 256 colors! In this RiscOS gem from 1997, the fate of human civilization lies in your hands. Travel the stars, claim uninhabited planets or fight over them against your alien opponents. Your ultimate chance to relive the original experience of this 4X sci-fi strategy sim, on the PC for the first time ever.
